projects.title: Sales Forecast Web: AI-Powered Sales Forecast Platform
projects.shortDescription: Full-stack platform that replaces forecast spreadsheets with a collaborative flow featuring approvals, audit trail, and AI-assisted forecasting
projects.problem: Multiple sales units consolidated monthly forecasts in loose email spreadsheets: each manager filled their own, consolidation was manual, approvals happened outside the file, and there was no reliable history of who changed what.
projects.solution: Web platform with a state-based flow (draft → submission → approval), an AI engine that tests 6 statistical time-series models per product/unit and selects the one with the lowest error, and consolidated dashboards comparing budgeted × forecast × actual sales.
impact: Controls forecasting today for 600+ SKUs across 8 sales units, both domestic and export
AI engine tests 6 statistical models per series and automatically selects the lowest-error one
Complete replacement of spreadsheets with a single flow with full audit trail
Bidirectional ERP integration for data sync and results export
projects.infrastructureRole: Docker Compose orchestration with Traefik as reverse proxy, Airflow DAGs for ERP sync and forecast engine execution, dual authentication (user JWT + static token for internal Airflow calls).
projects.disclaimer: This project uses fictional data for portfolio presentation; the usage metrics and benefits come from the real application, gathered with key users.

projects.title: App Stability Control: Stability Study Management
projects.shortDescription: Platform that controls medical product stability studies and automatically allocates incubator capacity by volume, with simulation before confirming
projects.problem: Stability studies track how a product behaves over time under controlled temperature and humidity conditions. Done manually (spreadsheet plus visual chamber tracking), the process loses traceability as the volume of studies grows: it's easy to allocate an incubator beyond capacity, lose track of who changed what, or miss a conflicting condition between two concurrent studies in the same chamber.
projects.solution: Allocation engine that measures capacity by volume, not by a fixed shelf position, so boxes of different sizes can share the same incubator. Before confirming a study, the simulator tests every compatible chamber considering the required condition, the occupancy of concurrent studies, and overlapping time windows, reporting the best option or the reason for the conflict.
impact: Volume-based allocation engine: accounts for each box's real size, not fixed shelf positions
Exclusive-condition-per-chamber rule: blocks two studies with different temperature/humidity requirements from overlapping in time, even when the incubator physically supports both
Progressive capacity release on each confirmed sample withdrawal, not only at the end of the study
Automatic scheduling by study type, including a built-in accelerated-study calculator
Automatic protocol and final report generation in PDF, consolidating results from every checkpoint
projects.infrastructureRole: Docker container deployment, schema versioned with Prisma Migrate, semantic release pipeline with Conventional Commits.
projects.disclaimer: This project uses fictional data for portfolio presentation; the architecture and business rules reflect the real application, still in development.

projects.title: FinanceFlow: Accounting Apportionment Automation
projects.shortDescription: Modular platform that automates accounting apportionment, reconciles fiscal documents, and posts automatically to an ERP, with a pluggable architecture for new processes
projects.problem: Departments like HR and Finance manually processed recurring accounting postings (health plan premiums, payroll paycheck deductions, vendor invoices), checking the calculated value against the invoice or bill in a spreadsheet: repetitive work prone to human error (wrong percentage, a forgotten cost center, duplicate postings) with no audit trail of who posted what.
projects.solution: Platform with a pluggable module architecture: each apportionment type is an independent package, auto-discovered at startup, so adding a new process means copying a template, with no changes to the rest of the system. One flow for all of them: document upload → apportionment calculated by cost center → automatic reconciliation against the fiscal value → ERP posting → notification to whoever needs to know.
impact: Saves 2 to 3 days of work for 2 employees per cycle on the processes already automated, with room to grow as each new process is migrated onto the platform
Pluggable module architecture: 5 active apportionment processes today (health plan premiums, payroll deductions, vendor invoices), each added without touching the application core

Complex business rules handled centrally: a salary-percentage discount cap, consolidating an employee's multiple health plans into a single posting, automatically resolving duplicate employment records across companies in the same group
Anti-partial lock with selective resend: a partial ERP failure never duplicates postings that were already accepted
projects.infrastructureRole: Python backend (FastAPI + SQLAlchemy 2.0) with idempotent migrations, JWT authentication with bcrypt, Docker deployment, automated semantic versioning (semantic-release) with a ruff and mypy quality gate.
projects.disclaimer: This project uses fictional data for portfolio presentation; the usage metrics and benefits come from the real application, gathered with key users.
